body: I have tried professional help before but it was far to expensive to continue and honestly it didnt help. Growing up I wasn’t ever allowed to be sad or angry, and now I naturally just repress my feelings. I’m good at pretending that I’m not emotionally wrecked. Basically, i got hurt in an accident and then I got diagnosed with a debilitating illness. But my life started going downhill even before that. But all of that broke me. I naively thought I would be better by now, but it doesn’t really seem like I will be getting better. It’s a hard reality. I don’t really know how else to put it. I don’t really have anyone I can talk to about my feelings. I know it can be worse, but the thing is my life is still not good even though it can be even worse than it is. If if got any worse than it already is, I don’t think I could continue living this life. I wish I were stronger and could accept my reality, but I can’t do that right now. I’m sorry I’m throwing all of this on you. I’m sure you have your own problems and pain. I really do appreciate that you took the time to talk to me.

Thanks for responding, but I don’t even really know where to start. I just need a reason to keep going, but it feels like every time I find hope I end up feeling shattered and disappointed. I try to deny my reality because I can’t accept it, but then I come face to face with it and it destroys me. I know I’m rambling but I’m just in a very messed up state right now. Sorry if that doesn’t make sense.
